description: Made of full 4130 chromoly, the Lineage frame weighs in just under 6 pounds and features a 75 degree head angle, 13.75” rear center, and an 11.5” BB. The wrap around head-tube gusset is what visually makes this frame look unique, but it re-enforces and strengthens the down-tube where frames are prone to break. Other features include our new investment-cast dropouts, and a CNC machined seat-tube, head-tube, and BB shell. The Lineage is ridden by team riders Ryan Nyquist, Pat Casey and DMC Dennis McCoy
